items.title: Jang interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2013
items.q: Actually it was more that Paul Robeson was nicknamed Mr. Pentatonic by Dizzy Gillespie.

ctx.x: Well it’s sort of a universal connection maybe I should say. Not universal music. Actually it was more that Paul Robeson was nicknamed Mr. Pentatonic by Dizzy Gillespie. In one of my talks about Paul, tradition and transformation, — are you coming to the Tradition and Transformation presentation I’m giving today at 4:00?
